[[GRK Tikvesh|Handball]] |} '''GFK Tikvesh 1930''' ({{langx|mk|Градски Фудбалски Клуб Тиквеш 1930}}), commonly referred to as '''Tikvesh''', is a professional [[association football|football]] club from [[Kavadarci]] that competes in the [[Macedonian First Football League|Macedonian First League]]. After playing at different home grounds in the early years,Karovski, Ilija (1996) FK Tikvesh 1930–1995 p. 15, 162 the club moved to [[Gradski Stadion Kavadarci]] on 19 March 1950 and have remained there since. The 'golden age' of the club came in the late 1960s and lasted throughout the entire 1970s. Tikvesh had won the [[List of Macedonian football champions|Macedonian Republic League]] twice ([[1971–72 Macedonian Republic League|1971–72]]; [[1977–78 Macedonian Republic League|1977–78]]), and they have competed in the [[Yugoslav Second League]] for five seasons (1955–56; [[1968–69 Yugoslav Second League|1968–69]]; 1969–70; 1972–73; [[1978–79 Yugoslav Second League|1978–79]]). Tikvesh was one of the 18 founding members of the [[1992–93 Macedonian First Football League|Macedonian First League]] in 1992. In the [[2023–24 Macedonian Football Cup|2023–24]] season the club has won their first [[Macedonian Football Cup]]. The club's traditional colours are red and white, they are nicknamed the Winegrowers and they have contested the Winegrowers Derby with their neighbouring rivals [[FK Vardar Negotino]], although Tikvesh have predominantly played in higher league so their meetings have only been sporadic."}}
